Compound explorer

Snapshot 2026-11-15.1: 41,463 activity rows for 18,400 compounds. Filter by compound (InChIKey prefix, any case, or SMILES fragment, case-sensitive), assay type, variant, source and pIC50 range. Every row links to the record it came from. Flagged rows are kept and labelled, as the snapshot keeps them. Back to the security report.
